reason:
Operator-adjudicated close of Set 117 Session 1 with one Major standing,
accepted as true and unmet rather than resolved or waived as wrong.

WHAT VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RAN. Cross-provider throughout; the
orchestrator's own provider (anthropic) was excluded by the router via
model-registry lookup on every call.

  Round 1, phase=discovery, 2026-08-10. Fan-out 2/2, lenses
  spec-conformance and failure-scenario. Verifier: gpt-5-6-sol,
  effective provider openai, task_type=session-verification, template
  ai_router/prompt-templates (session-verification). Verdict
  ISSUES_FOUND, 4 blocking findings (2 distinct Majors, each raised
  independently by BOTH lenses). Raw artifacts:
  s1-verification.md and s1-verification-fanout-2.md; structured
  findings s1-issues.json. Cost $0.7962.

  Round 2, phase=remediation-review, 2026-08-10. Verifier:
  gpt-5-6-sol, effective provider openai. Fix verdicts: 1 accepted,
  1 rejected. Raw artifact: s1-verification-round-2.md; structured
  findings s1-issues-round-2.json. Cost $0.1257.

  Acceptance harness ran for round 1 (s1-acceptance-round-1.json): all
  four findings carry JUDGMENT criteria, so none was auto-closed by
  baseline discrimination -- they settle only by remediation-review.
  Ledger: s1-rounds.jsonl.

WHAT WAS SETTLED. Round 1's Major on unsupported causal claims was
remediated and the fix was ACCEPTED in round 2. All seven nits were
fixed, none deferred. Remediation is documented per-finding in
s1-remediation-round-1.md.

WHAT IS NOT SETTLED, AND IS NOT BEING CLAIMED AS SETTLED. The second
Major -- that the session never re-ran the previously-failing 8-worker
Layer 3 configuration on the host where it failed -- was REJECTED in
round 2 on the correct ground that "the remediation documents the
missing measurement instead of performing it." The orchestrator does
not dispute this. It is unmet because the measurement is not obtainable
from this session: the configuration failed on the operator's 14-core /
31.5 GB work machine, and this session ran on DENICI (20 CPUs, 63.8 GB),
a different physical machine. No further work on DENICI produces the
missing measurement, so authorizing another round would buy a restated
finding rather than settling evidence.

THE OPERATOR'S ADJUDICATION. On 2026-08-10, presented with an
education-mode brief naming four options (close with the residual owed;
leave the session open until the 14-core run happens; waive the finding
as discharged by documentation; seek a third-provider opinion), the
operator chose: "Close S1, owe it to S2." Recorded verbatim in
decisions.jsonl with authority=human, rubric_line=accountability-sign-off.

The finding is therefore an OWED RESIDUAL WITH A NAMED OWNER: Session 2,
as a precondition before any worker count is adopted for the 14-core
host. It is recorded in s1-worker-sweep-DENICI.txt section 2, in
ai-assignment.md under what Session 2 inherits, and in
disposition.next_orchestrator.reason.specifics. If Session 2 also runs
on DENICI, the residual carries to Session 3 and must be restated, not
dropped. The adjudication settles the STOP, not the truth.

SUITE EVIDENCE ON THE FINAL TREE, all after the last code change:
Layer 3 FULL 36 passed in 659s at the shipping workers:1; pytest 3850
passed / 5 skipped in 297s at -n 8 (the operator's standing cap, not
pytest.ini's -n auto); mocha 1689 passing / 1 failing on a PRE-EXISTING
sampleProjectSmoke close_session gate_failed, reproduced on clean master
with this session's changes stashed and recorded honestly as outcome=failed
in test-runs.jsonl rather than as passed.
